rule: item sealed iff its key is in no development file (every *.sample*.jsonl, every dataset a stored run read, and every committed *.jsonl under evals/ such as test fixtures) and int(sha256('lid-heldout-v1|'+key)[:8],16) % 100 < 30; key = CVE id for CVE items (sealed jointly across suites), else suite|sha256(normalized content)
use: never run sealed items during harness development; only in a pre-registered confirmatory run

prospective.nvd-recent: CVEs published 2026-10-01..2026-10-31 (fetch only after 2026-11-30, only for a confirmatory run; never used for development)
